name: Make a wax seal
blurb: A five-minute skill that makes any letter or gift memorable. The only real technique is temperature control and letting it cool before you lift.
gear: Sealing wax — flexible wax if it will go through the post
A spoon and a heat source, or a glue-gun style wax applicator
steps: Melt the wax gently in a spoon over a candle, or use a glue-gun applicator, until it flows like honey without smoking.
Pour a pool of even thickness onto the paper — about a coin’s worth, in one continuous pour.
Let it cool for a few seconds until the surface just loses its wet shine.
Press the stamp straight down, without twisting, and hold for about fifteen seconds.
Lift straight up. If it sticks, chill the stamp in cold water first or lightly grease it.
Use flexible sealing wax for anything posted, since traditional wax shatters in a sorting machine.
tips: Stamping while the wax is too hot gives a shallow, smeared impression. Wait for the shine to dull.
Overheated wax turns brown and bubbles. Melt it slowly.
proof: Three consecutive crisp, fully detailed seals with no smearing or sticking.
